title: Smart Data Models - Brick Schema - Point
description: A telemetry point exposed by a piece of building Equipment or associated with a Location: a sensor, setpoint, command, status, alarm or parameter (brick:Point and its subclasses, Brick Schema). This candidate models Point generically -- see the brickClass property -- rather than as hundreds of separate entity types.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Point'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Human-readable label (rdfs:label in the source).

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

brickClass.description: Relationship. The specific Brick class of this point (e.g. https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#CO2_Level_Sensor). Brick's Point hierarchy has 937 leaf classes (Sensor/Setpoint/Command/Status/Alarm/Parameter subtypes) -- far too many to model as separate NGSI-LD entity types, so this candidate uses a single generic 'Point' entity with the specific class captured here as a Relationship to the class URI, rather than instantiating hundreds of distinct schemas.

isPointOf.description: Relationship. The Equipment or Location this point belongs to (brick:isPointOf). The target may be an entity type not covered by this candidate (e.g. a room or zone, which Brick's own real examples typically model via the companion RealEstateCore ontology, out of scope here -- see standard-metadata.yaml).

hasUnit.description: Relationship. The unit of measurement, as a QUDT unit concept URI (brick:hasUnit), e.g. http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/PPM.

aggregate.description: Property. How the point's raw data is reduced before storage (brick:aggregate).

resolution.description: Property. The smallest change in value the point's sensor can distinguish (brick:resolution).

hasExternalReference.description: Property. A pointer to where this point's actual time-series data is stored (ref:hasExternalReference) -- Brick deliberately separates point metadata (this entity) from the time-series data itself, which is exactly the NGSI-LD pattern of separating an entity's current state from its historical data in a context broker.

hasTimeseriesId.description: Property. Opaque identifier of the timeseries (ref:hasTimeseriesId).

storedAt.description: Property. Connection string / location of the timeseries store (ref:storedAt).
